About the Scholarship

The Danish application window for international applicants typically opens on 1 February and closes on 1 March for a September start.

ApplyOfficial application page ↗

SDU awards scholarships to talented non-EU/EEA master's applicants — tuition waivers, sometimes with a monthly living grant — allocated automatically with the admission application. The Danish application window for international applicants typically opens on 1 February and closes on 1 March for a September start.

Programme Highlights

  • No separate scholarship application — decided with admission
  • Tuition waivers with living-grant options for the strongest files
  • February-March application window per the Danish national system
  • Programmes across engineering, science, business and humanities

Who Should Apply

Non-EU/EEA applicants to SDU English-taught master's programmes, ranked academically within each programme.

Funding and Costs

Partial or full tuition waivers, some combined with monthly living grants, awarded with admission to top-ranked applicants. Confirm the exact funding package on the official page before applying.

Deadline and How to Apply

Apply through the Danish optagelse portal during the February window; the scholarship decision follows the admission result. Key deadline information: Scholarships assessed with admission; non-EU application window typically 1 February – 1 March for a September start.

Official Link

  • Official application page (verified link)

About University of Southern Denmark (SDU)

The University of Southern Denmark is a comprehensive Danish university with campuses in Odense and beyond, funding non-EU/EEA master's students through automatic scholarship awards.

Official website: https://www.sdu.dk

Contact

Questions about this position, eligibility or the application process should be raised through the contact channel given on the official announcement page (see the Official Link section above). Always quote the position reference in your message so the admissions or HR team can route your enquiry quickly.

Important Notes

  • Application deadline: Scholarships assessed with admission - late or incomplete applications are normally not considered.
  • Listing details were recorded from the official source at the time of publication; always confirm the latest requirements on the official page before applying.
  • Prepare the documents listed in the eligibility and application sections before starting the online form - transcripts, CV and references take the longest to collect.
